title: Analysis and stability of the FitzHugh-Nagumo system with rapidly oscillating Neumann boundary condition
summary: In this paper we study the FitzHugh-Nagumo system posed on the half-line with a sinusoidal forcing term acting at the origin through the Neumann boun\-da\-ry condition. By applying an averaging method, we show that, if the frequency of the oscillating forcing is high enough, then the system can be approximated by a combination of a highly-oscillatory term and the solution of a simpler system. This approach allows us to establish stability results under persistent time-varying boundary conditions. Along with the averaging method, we use an adaptation of the contracting rectangles method,…
